PM Modi Questions India Inc on Tax Cuts, Wages, and Jobs

Prime Minister Narendra Modi questioned Indian corporations at the annual FICCI gathering in New Delhi, asking why they had not increased employee salaries or created more jobs despite receiving tax cuts. He presented figures indicating rising corporate profits alongside stagnant or declining real employee earnings. Modi directly challenged the companies, stating, "I gave tax cuts, have you hiked salaries, created jobs?" He also asked, "If you reduced taxes, did you increase employee salaries?"
